client_need: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control
stem: Before a hospitalized client begins eating, the nurse assists the client with hand hygiene. What is the primary infection-prevention purpose of this action?

options.A: Reduce the transfer of germs from the hands to food or the mouth
options.B: Eliminate the need for other food-safety precautions
options.C: Improve appetite without affecting infection risk
options.D: Replace the need to clean visibly contaminated eating surfaces

rationale: CDC advises handwashing before eating because it helps prevent germs from spreading to food or the mouth. Therefore A is correct. Hand hygiene does not replace other food-safety or environmental-cleaning practices, so B and D are incorrect; C ignores the infection-prevention purpose.
educational_objective: Use hand hygiene before eating to reduce transfer of germs from the hands to food or the mouth as part of infection prevention.
source_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
source_document_title: Food Safety Tips for Dining Out
source_locator: Section 'Once at the restaurant, follow these tips': 'Before eating, wash your hands with soap and running water. This helps prevent germs spreading to your food or mouth.'
source_claim_supported: Handwashing before eating helps prevent germs from spreading from the hands to food or the mouth.
